extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans.

composition.coaching_note: Agent, you did a great job delivering the TPMO disclaimer prior to discussing any benefits. However, you could have saved time by scheduling the follow-up appointment after the call, as the customer was already on the line and ready to proceed. Try to incorporate this into your next call.
composition.summary: The call was compliant with CMS contract year 2027 marketing rules. The TPMO disclaimer was delivered prior to discussing any benefits, and the Scope of Appointment was collected before the plan discussion. The agent did not use any superlatives or make any materially misleading claims. The call was scheduled for follow-up.
